record.name: ClickUp
record.one_liner: Task management and productivity platform that enables teams to manage projects, tasks, goals, and documents.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free ClickUp account and generate personal API tokens or create OAuth apps directly in their settings.
record.api_note: The API covers tasks, custom fields, comments, goals, folders, lists, attachments, webhooks, and chat views.

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the ClickUp API using a personal token or OAuth.
If you don’t have an account yet, you can sign up for free and create your first Workspace!
ClickUp API empowers you to create custom workflows, integrate seamlessly with your favorite tools
ClickUp's MCP Server is available on all plans.
Build your own custom integrations and ClickUp apps with our public Application Programming Interface (API).
